# BedSpawn

**Tags:** `world-system`

A bed a player places becomes where they come back after death. One bed per player; the bed must be placed like a station, and a shelter rule says when the space around it is a roofed room.

> **Goal:** Give a new player a home in their first hour and a reason to build a shelter

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `rules` | json | yes | Bed rule: { stationType, placementItem, perPlayer, notices: { placed, lost }, shelter: { roofWithinMetres, sideReachMetres, minClosedSides, wallCheckMetres } } (validated at fabric load) |

## Behaviors

### `place`

Place a bed as a station; it becomes the owner's spawn point

**Rules:**
- Placing consumes one Bed item
- A player owns at most perPlayer beds; a new one replaces the oldest

**Auth:** `maintainer`

### `shelter`

Decide whether a bed is sheltered

**Rules:**
- A solid run starts above the bed and no more than roofWithinMetres above it
- At least minClosedSides of the four sides have solid material at wall height within sideReachMetres

**Auth:** `maintainer`
